task: Predict overall survival in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma using discretized time bins. Each class represents one of four survival quartiles from earliest to latest follow-up, combined with censored status or death event. On H&E, adverse features include poor differentiation, infiltrative growth, marked desmoplasia, perineural or lymphovascular invasion, tumor budding, and necrosis.

classes.0: Earliest survival quartile, censored — short follow-up without recorded death.
classes.1: Second survival quartile, censored — intermediate-short follow-up without recorded death.
classes.2: Third survival quartile, censored — intermediate-long follow-up without recorded death.
classes.3: Latest survival quartile, censored — longest follow-up without recorded death.
classes.4: Earliest survival quartile, event — death occurred early, consistent with highly aggressive pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma morphology.
classes.5: Second survival quartile, event — death occurred at an intermediate-early timepoint.
classes.6: Third survival quartile, event — death occurred at an intermediate-late timepoint.
classes.7: Latest survival quartile, event — death occurred late after relatively prolonged survival.
